Emilie Cheng

Bio

Emilie Cheng is a second-year Master’s student in Epidemiology at Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health. Her academic background began in Veterinary Medicine (DVM) at National Taiwan University, and she is now expanding her expertise into clinical trials, pharmacoepidemiology, and pharmacovigilance.
